name: The Elevator That Arrives Twice
premise:
The lobby elevator opens with a polite chime. At the same time, the indicator
above the same door insists the car is still descending from floor 9. A courier
steps toward the open car, ready to become a witness to two arrivals at once.

objective.description: Stop the duplicate elevator arrival from being witnessed.

anchors.name: black_notebook
anchors.description: A worn black notebook filled with your own handwriting.

anchors.name: commute_memory
anchors.description: The ordinary rhythm of waiting for elevators in office lobbies.

elevator.observe_text:
The elevator is physically here with doors open. Closing the doors would
stop the courier entering, but it would not explain why the same car was
also still descending.

indicator.observe_text:
The indicator shows floor 9 and a downward arrow. Patching the display
would hide the symptom from the lobby, but not fix the route record behind
it.

dispatch.observe_text:
The dispatch panel has split one car into two records: one arrived, one
descending. Correct the call ledger and the visible facts can reconcile.

courier.observe_text:
The courier is one step from entering. A brief delay buys time, but the
contradiction still needs a causal repair.

coherent.scene_message:
You merge the two dispatch records into one route. The indicator blinks,
accepts the lobby arrival, and the courier sees only a normal elevator.
coherent.system_note: Source bookkeeping repair. Visible scene rationalizes itself.
coherent.discovered_rule: Fix low-level bookkeeping before editing the public symptom.

lobby.scene_message:
The indicator flips to L. The contradiction is hidden at the panel, but
the dispatch record strains underneath it.
lobby.system_note: Symptom edit. Coherent enough for witnesses, but collateral settles later.

close.scene_message:
The doors slide shut before the courier enters. The witness is delayed,
but the panel still says the car is elsewhere.
close.system_note: Delay only. The duplicate-arrival contradiction remains unresolved.

hesitate.scene_message: The courier checks a notification and pauses for a breath.
hesitate.system_note: Buys time without solving the source inconsistency.

duplicate_arrival.text:
The door and indicator disagree because the dispatch ledger duplicated a
car route. Fixing the route record is quieter than forcing doors or displays.

scene_progression.message:
The courier steps into the open elevator while the indicator still counts
down from 9. Their certainty locks the contradiction in place.

hidden_rules: Repair source bookkeeping before public symptoms when records disagree.
Delaying a witness helps only if the causal contradiction is also resolved.
